title: Bind PR4268 half-cut heads to the literal eight-stream operator
body:
PR4268 explicitly requests a replay of its half-cut heads in the community's exact eight-stream model. This binds the **unchanged PR2979 T74 allocation** to that model: the actual chronology classifies 8,064 child-8 and 8,022 child-10 first-touch heads, and four representative 24-axis cuts pass all eight dirty-input columns on 79 characters each. A wrong non-head cut fails at `chi=2^25`, leaking `1-i` from Y0 to Y1 where the required map has zero. Complete axes, hosted occurrences, primitive events and matrices are retained.

The written lemma identifies the input-side correction and its literal first-touch premise. A separate dense Gaussian-integer implementation agrees on all 344 tested matrices (22,016 entries), including the rejecting control. Event extraction is shared and separately reviewed. The 16,086-head statement comes from full structural owner/port classification; four matrix fixtures do not prove a symmetry or enumerate `2^73` labels.

Validation: both registered normal and optimized Python3.12 commands explicitly use `-I -W error -B`, regenerate and compare all typed data, and reject three meaningful evidence corruptions. Exact source-history, public bytes and Git-free committed export receipts accompany the handoff. Runtime uses only the 19 declared inputs; the earlier export failure is preserved in the session evidence and corrected before this PR. No dependencies added.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-cut-eight-stream-binding
```

Scope: identity cover and completed-local-invocation contract only. Source geometry and completed-call semantics remain premises for interpreting the phase deletion as a 49-axis job; Gram geometry, native internals, other covers, precision, storage/restoration/stock, mixed-recursion outer admission and new kappa are unclaimed. The latest PR4268 comments report external A-fc Lean work; this does not repeat that stale question.

Credit Jacob Sussman/4268, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/2979, Nick Petalas/3187, Gareth Davidson/1387 and Rohan Arun, plus the unchanged notices and E8/native/owner lineage. New work by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI proof, engine, dense arithmetic and static review contexts. Apache-2.0. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or selected-frontier change.
